title: Mustard chicken with Savoy and butter beans

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Chicken, onions, mustard, honey, cider vinegar, cabbage and tinned butter beans are all ordinary home cupboard and fridge foods.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient is an everyday item at any mainstream UK supermarket.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a roasting tray and a small bowl, and the technique is simple roasting.

works.reason: Eight bone-in thighs roasted 45 minutes at 200°C will cook through, and half a Savoy with two tins of beans gives four sensible portions with enough seasoning from the mustard dressing.

honest_times.reason: Wedging two onions, shredding half a cabbage, draining beans and mixing the dressing fits 15 minutes, and the 30 plus 15 minute roast matches the 45 minutes cook time.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning is used in the steps, the names match their ids, and nothing unlisted appears.

seasonal_feel.reason: A warm mustardy traybake suits early November, and the Savoy is a main component that crisps on the tray, not a garnish.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, plain British English that a beginner could follow.

hearty_healthy.reason: Chicken, beans and a good amount of cabbage make a balanced, filling family dinner.
